security_spec.violation_condition: In QEMU TCG, when translating PLI.W/PLUI.W on RV32 (where XLEN=32, XLEN/32=1, so the loop body executes once and sign-extension to 32 bits is a no-op), or when translating PLI.DB/PLI.DH/PLUI.DH register-pair destination instructions without checking that rd_p is properly aligned (even register) and that rd_p != 0 before writing both registers of the pair
security_spec.summary: New P-ext packed load-immediate instructions: incorrect sign-extension width, XLEN-dependent loop bounds, or register-pair destination validation in TCG translation can cause silent data corruption in guest register state
